standard_prerequisites.name: Inertia as a double fibre product
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies X x_{X x X} X with the inertia and the double diagonal with its identity section.

core_obligations: Unpack (1) via the inertia identification: the locus where alpha = id_x is representable.
Unpack (2) for pairs of morphisms alpha, beta: the locus where alpha = beta is representable.
Prove (1) => (2) by applying (1) to alpha^{-1} beta and (2) => (1) by taking h = id and beta = id.
proof_roadmap: Translate both conditions into equality-of-morphisms representability via the inertia interpretation, then link them by the inverse trick alpha^{-1} o beta = id and its trivial specialization.
difficulty_reason: Purely formal translation, but the double-fibre-product bookkeeping and the inverse trick must both be got right.
